<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
In a Free Company you add your own character, and Alagos signs you up with the job for the role you press.

## Add your character

Open `/my-profile`, then the Final Fantasy XIV tab, then **👤 My characters** and **➕ Add my character**. Give its **name**, its **World**, and, if you like, your item level and FF Logs link. Then open it and pick your **main job** and **second job**, and tick **every job you play** under **🎭 Jobs I play**.

## Sign up for a party

Press the role you will play: **Tank**, **Pure healer**, **Barrier healer**, **Melee**, **Ranged** or **Caster**. Alagos signs you up as your main job if it plays that role, else your second job, else another job you play. The post shows you with it, like **Wol · Scholar**.

In the answer only you see, you can switch job or character. If your role is full you go on its **bench** and move up by yourself; Alagos tells you in a DM.
{% endraw %}
